text:
noah: Quick design sync on ButtonGroup + table focus + toast stacking. Found a few inconsistencies in the new console draft.

priya: hit me.

noah: ButtonGroup: when there are 4+ compact buttons we overflow into a horizontal scroll on mobile. it's awkward to discover and the overflow shadow conflicts with the focus ring.

li: right. also the visual gap between buttons uses `--spacing-1` which is an atomic token that teams keep changing. we should introduce a semantic token like `--component-gap-sm` so we can change spacing in one place.

priya: good call. For overflow discoverability can we switch to a collapse into a "more" menu at <= 420px? that keeps keyboard access clean.

zhang: :+1: collapse is better than scroll. keyboard navigation should still tab through visible buttons and offer `aria-haspopup` on the more menu.

noah: quick CSS sketch for focus and collapse behavior:
```css
.button-group { display:flex; gap: var(--component-gap-sm, 8px); }
.button-group .btn { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius:6px; }
.button-group .btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }
@media (max-width:420px) { .button-group.collapse { /* collapse into .more */ } }
```

li: also noticed table row focus ring is currently using `neutral-800` which disappears in dark mode because the row background is also dark. should use `--focus-ring` token instead of color literal.

priya: right — use token, not hex. And ensure the focus ring has enough contrast in both themes (maybe 3:1 at minimum for outlines).

noah: toasts: they stack top-right by default. sticky table headers on some dashboards cause toasts to sit under the header (visually clipped) or overlap action controls. can we prefer top-center for pages with sticky headers, or push the toast stacking z-index above headers?

zhang: prefer avoiding top-center for global notifications; it's a pattern change. simpler: make toast respect `--page-header-safe-offset` if present (default 0). then pages with sticky headers set it to header height and toasts will nudge down.

li: agree. also add `--toast-stack-gap: 8px` and ensure toasts have `pointer-events: auto` so they don't block button clicks under them.

priya: small copy nit on the primary button in machine-setup modal: "Start deployment" reads like an action but could be ambiguous. suggestion: "Deploy model" to be more explicit.

noah: noted. i'll open a copy PR for that modal.

zhang: I'll prototype the ButtonGroup collapse + more menu and attach screenshots.

li: I'll prepare the token rename proposal to add `--component-gap-sm/med/lg` and deprecate `--spacing-1` in components.

design-bot: Created TASKS-983 "ButtonGroup: collapse on narrow, semantic spacing tokens, focus token alignment; Table focus token fixes; Toast safe-offset & stack gap" Target:v2.18.0

noah: action items recap: 1) implement `--component-gap-*` tokens and map existing usage, 2) ButtonGroup collapse into more menu at <=420px, 3) use `--focus-ring` token for table rows, 4) add `--page-header-safe-offset` and `--toast-stack-gap`, 5) change modal CTA copy to "Deploy model".

priya: all good from my side.

li: will follow up with PRs and token proposal doc.

zhang: will post prototypes by EOD.

noah: thanks team. resolving once PRs land.
